the physical workload of low wage hotel room cleaners was associated with the prevalence of low back and knee pain.

the physical work environment of low wage workers in the hotel room cleaning industry in Las Vegas was characterized by high work intensity and physical workload and was associated with the prevalence of musculoskeletal pain.
